long_biography.plain_text:
Vehicle support that Dave Hagewood added to Unreal Tournament 2003 led Epic Games to hire him as a contractor on the Onslaught mode. The project taught him how a professional game studio operated and gave Psyonix a speciality in Unreal technology, which it used for work with larger developers.

Psyonix's first car-football game attracted a committed audience but exposed problems in speed, accessibility and online infrastructure. Hagewood kept the concept alive while paid projects sustained the company, then supported a more focused redesign. Rocket League slowed the action, rebuilt multiplayer systems and put the sport at the centre, turning a patient second attempt into the studio's breakthrough.
